repos.name: trycompai/crm
repos.description: Comp AI CRM is an open source, CRM designed for AI agents. Agentic-first CRM.
repos.one_liner: An open-source, agent-first CRM platform designed specifically to integrate with and support autonomous AI agents.
bullets: Built with a modern TypeScript stack optimized for agentic workflows.
Provides a structured data layer that allows AI agents to read, write, and manage customer relationships autonomously.
Enables automated lead qualification, personalized outreach, and CRM data maintenance without human intervention.
Designed to bridge the gap between traditional sales operations and the emerging agent-based enterprise architecture.

repos.name: FedericoTs/quantprobe
repos.description: Run a 110B on a 2016 PC with 16 GB RAM. Know your tok/s before you download. Placement beats budget: predicts speed + memory fit for any GGUF on your exact hardware, self-calibrates, emits the exact llama.cpp command — or 'quantprobe auto' does it all. Falsification-tested laws; misses published at full size. pip install quantprobe
repos.one_liner: A diagnostic tool that predicts inference performance and memory requirements for GGUF models on specific hardware configurations.
bullets: Uses a Python-based calibration engine to benchmark hardware capabilities against model architecture.
Predicts tokens-per-second and memory fit for large models (e.g., 110B) on constrained or legacy hardware.
Allows finance and tech professionals to optimize local LLM deployment costs by matching model size to exact hardware specs.
Eliminates the trial-and-error process of downloading massive model files that may not run on local workstations.

repos.name: opensible/opensible
repos.description: An open source GitOps control plane for OpenTofu & Ansible - provision, configure and deploy across cloud, on-prem and hybrid, self-hosted and forever free.
repos.one_liner: An open-source GitOps control plane for OpenTofu and Ansible, enabling unified infrastructure management across hybrid environments.
bullets: Python-based control plane that orchestrates infrastructure-as-code (IaC) workflows.
Provides a centralized GitOps interface for provisioning and configuring cloud, on-prem, and hybrid resources.
Supports self-hosted, free-tier infrastructure management, reducing reliance on expensive proprietary cloud management platforms.
Ideal for DevOps teams looking to standardize deployment pipelines and maintain consistent state across complex enterprise environments.

repos.name: mikehasa/agentacct
repos.description: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A local-first observability and cost-tracking dashboard for AI coding agents.
bullets: Tech Stack: Python-based local dashboard designed to ingest logs from Claude Code, Codex, and OpenAI agents.
Purpose: Provides granular visibility into agentic workflows by tracking token consumption, latency, and financial costs per task.
Use Cases: Ideal for developers and finance teams needing to audit AI ROI, debug agent tool usage, and monitor spend on automated coding tasks.

repos.name: EthanXiang777/circuit-framework
repos.description: Circuit Framework — multi-agent LLM trading research system
repos.one_liner: A multi-agent LLM framework specifically architected for quantitative trading research.
bullets: Tech Stack: Python-based modular framework utilizing multi-agent orchestration for financial data analysis.
Purpose: Automates the research pipeline for trading strategies by delegating data retrieval, backtesting, and signal generation to specialized agents.
Use Cases: Streamlining the development of algorithmic trading strategies and conducting rapid hypothesis testing in financial markets.

repos.name: Flaminis/Dalaran
repos.description: Dalaran — Apache-2.0, robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure for multimodal time-series. ROS 2 native, reads existing .rrd recordings. A hard fork of Rerun.
repos.one_liner: A robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure tool for multimodal time-series data, built as a high-performance fork of Rerun.
bullets: Written in Rust, optimized for high-throughput ingestion and visualization of time-series data.
Native ROS 2 support allows for seamless integration into existing robotics and automated data pipelines.
Designed to handle complex, multi-sensor data streams with low latency, making it suitable for high-frequency trading backtesting or sensor fusion.
Provides a robust framework for replaying and analyzing historical data recordings (.rrd files) with advanced visual inspection.
